title: Create a single-file HTML page with an interactive 3D particle galaxy hero

messages.content:
Create a single-file HTML page with an interactive 3D particle galaxy hero
section using Three.js (load it from a CDN). Requirements: about 50,000
particles forming a spiral galaxy that slowly rotates; particle colors shift
from warm amber at the core to violet at the outer rim; add OrbitControls so
visitors can drag to rotate and zoom; overlay a centered hero headline that
says "Build Beyond Flat" with a short subline and a CTA button; set
pointer-events: none on the overlay container and pointer-events: auto on
the CTA button so the galaxy stays draggable behind the text; dark
background #0a0616; handle window resize. Output ONLY the complete HTML
file in a single code block.

Use https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/...

- Colors shift from warm amber core to violet outer rim
- OrbitControls drag rotate and zoom
- Centered hero headline "Build Beyond Flat" with subline and CTA button

- dark background #0a0616

Spiral galaxy generation: classic spiral — arms. For each particle, pick arm (e.g., 3 or 4), random radius with bias toward center? Standard approach: r = pow(random, something) * maxRadius; angle = r * winding + armOffset + gaussian spread. Add vertical spread small. Color lerp from amber (#ffb347 / #ff9a3c) to violet (#8b5cf6 / #7c3aed) by radius/t.

Particle material: PointsMaterial with vertexColors, size attenuation, additive blending for glow, round texture via canvas-generated sprite. Use a generated radial gradient texture for soft points.

Animation loop rotates the group slowly (rotation.y += speed). Also maybe rotate camera? No—OrbitControls handles it; rotating the galaxy group is fine. Enable damping. autoRotate could be used but requirement says slow rotation — I'll rotate group and also add slight controls damping.

Resize handler updates camera aspect and renderer size.
